### No Resurrection, No Savior
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-april-15-2017.html
Passage: 1 Corinthians 15:14, 17
Points:
- Without the resurrection of Jesus, Christian faith is futile and death retains its dominion over humanity.
- Christ's crucifixion alone cannot save anyone if He remains in the grave.
- The resurrection proves Jesus is truly God incarnate rather than an ordinary martyr with a delusion.
- Christ rising from the tomb confirms that the Father accepted His sacrifice at Calvary to justify believers.
